origin.description: Return only the neighbor distances from get.knnx.
origin.details: Cover-tree lengths are single precision. The kd-tree and the brute scan use double precision.
origin.example: knnx.dist of query points (1.2, 1.2) and (8.7, 8.7), k=3

translation.description: knnx_dist returns the Euclidean distances from get_knnx.
translation.details: Cover-tree lengths are single precision. The kd-tree and the brute scan use double precision.
translation.example: knnx.dist of query points (1.2, 1.2) and (8.7, 8.7), k=3
